# HexPiece 3.7.9

The new Leopard fruit, first part: the transformation, the base animations and the M1s. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and
all 13 test suites pass, and the model, the change, the flames and the blows were rendered and checked in previews.

## Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard (Legendary)
"New Fruit: Legendary Leopard Fruit, Name: Neko Neko No Mi, Type: Zoan, Model in the Zip, Size: 5 blocks tall"; "first of all, Z
(transformation, get the base animations, and m1s.)"
- **The fruit:** a new Legendary fruit with its own icon after your picture: a golden cat-faced fruit with pointed ears, leopard
  rosettes and the green T stem with its curl and bud.
- **Z, the transformation:** you slouch down as black flames rise round you and close into a ball of burning black flames with two
  evil red eyes glaring out of it. With a roar the ball bursts, everyone near is thrown back, and your leopard stands there: your
  model, 5 blocks tall. Z again: the black flames gather round the leopard into a bigger ball with the red eyes in it, and it burns
  away off you. Nothing grows or shrinks. As the leopard you run much faster. The sea takes the form away.
- **The leopard:** the game's own animations from your model's file: a breathing idle, a run whose pace follows how fast you move
  (the feet don't slide), the jump's take-off, the hang in the air and the landing. Its mane, the tuft of its tail, its elbow and
  shoulder hair, its beard and the ribbon round it are black flames: they lick and flow all the time and tongues of black flame keep
  rising off them. Its face changes: a snarl while it strikes, a wince when it is hurt, its roar when it changes; its hands close
  into fists as it strikes.
- **M1, Six Styles (both forms):** click by click a combo of five: a front kick, a claw swipe, a roundhouse kick, a double punch, and
  Rokuogan, both fists thrust out together in a white shock with a dark red rim that blows whoever it hits far away. White slashes
  and a ring of shock where each blow lands. The leopard throws the same five with its own martial-arts moves from your model and
  reaches further; the damage is the same. With the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, the Conqueror's lightning comes off each one hit
  and out of Rokuogan's blast. In first person your hand moves with each blow.
- **Transformed means fruit only:** as the leopard, R does not switch to your fighting style (as the dragon, phoenix and Gear 5).
- Not in yet: the other moves (Finger Pistol Barrage, Sonic Kick, Infinity Drive, Unrelenting Assault, Heavens Demise).
